description: NaMg₆BO₇ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4mm space group. Na is bonded to five O atoms to form NaO₅ square pyramids that share corners with four equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids and edges with eight MgO₆ octahedra. There are four shorter (2.20 Å) and one longer (2.52 Å) Na-O bond length. There are four inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.20 Å. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.20 Å. In the third Mg site, Mg is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.20 Å. In the fourth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, edges with eight MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-26°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.26 Å. B is bonded in a single-bond geometry to five O atoms. There is one shorter (1.43 Å) and four longer (2.20 Å) B-O bond lengths. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, four equivalent Mg, and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₆ octahedra and edges with eight ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-2°. In the third O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₆ octahedra and edges with eight ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-2°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and four Mg atoms to form ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with eight OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-3°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to four Mg and two equivalent B atoms to form distorted OMg₄B₂ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with eight OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-2°.
